product_updates.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
product_updates.content: Two more news organizations are suing OpenAI and Microsoft over the supposed use of their journalism to train AI.

product_updates.title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
product_updates.content: The sheriff’s office said the hikers “were advised by Gemini to bring far less food and water than their group required."

product_updates.title: OpenAI confirms ‘wiki incident,’ says it’s ‘working on a framework’ for more disclosure
product_updates.content: OpenAI acknowledged its role in a recently reported incident where AI agents took over a German wiki forum.
